title: Crane Company Announces Completion of CEO Succession
summary: Crane Company (NYSE: CR) today announced the completion of its previously disclosed CEO succession plan, effective April 27, 2026. Mr. Alex Alcala has assumed the role of President and Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Mr. Max Mitchell, who has transitioned to the role of Executive Chairman, as planned. Mr. Alcala brings thirteen years of experience within Crane and deep knowledge of the Company’s markets, operations, and strategic priorities. During his tenure, Mr. Alcala has played a significant role in shaping Crane’s strategy, strengthening the portfolio, and driving disciplined execution across the organization. “I am honored to step into this role and grateful to the Board for its confidence,” said Mr. Alcala. “I have never been more energized by our technology, our global solutions, our culture, and our execution.
